notes: Bank = 324 mono cues. 301 are reachable at runtime, 23 are not: 12 dead effect cues and 11 mono WAV copies of music tracks (the stereo 'music.wav', 'title.wav', 'victory.wav' are skipped by the packer; title/victory go to streams.bin).

room_ variants: Game.sound_at plays the dry cue positionally and, if the PLAYER's own cell has a roof (not the source's), also plays 'room_'+name when it exists in the bank at 55% of the positional volume (sound.gd scales room_* by a further .72). Game.report (player muzzle guns except the arm gun) does the same centred at .78 but without a has() check.
Missing: Game.report requests room_cow_launcher and room_teat_gun, which are not in the bank; Sound.play drops them silently, so those two guns have no indoor tail.

Plain sound.play() calls never get a room twin: gallery revolver, sound.play('gate') on exit-clear/level-finish, crowbar/slingblade/crossbow/ripsaw/armgun/bowling_ball/powder_keg reports, hits, reloads, equips, pickups, footsteps.

VARIANTS in sound.gd is strict round-robin, not random: each request for rifle/revolver/hurt/yee_haw advances a per-name counter (rifle -> rifle, rifle_alt, rifle_alt2; revolver -> revolver, revolver_alt; hurt x3; yee_haw x2). Gain/priority/room lookup still use the base name, so room_rifle and room_revolver are shared by all variants. Bark code also requests yee_haw_alt directly.

Looping cues (Assets.set_loop LOOP_FORWARD over the whole sample, so they must loop seamlessly end-to-start): all 11 amb_* beds, jukebox, fuse_hiss, saw_motor; plus the 'title' stream. Everything else is one-shot.

Voices: 14 general effect voices (new requests are dropped when all are busy unless the name is in PRIORITY, which gets a dedicated overflow voice), 2 ambience voices (crossfade .33s), radio, fuse, tool, sting, voice, and 2 warning voices.

WARNS cues (enemy wind-ups, sheriff_siren, whistle, pressure_vent, ...) are not retriggered while the same cue is still playing, so their length gates how often the telegraph can repeat; pressure_vent is a WARN even when used as a reload beat, station cue or scenery rupture. pause_world() cuts WARNS and the priority voice.

Dual-use cues: deputy_work, tosser_rattle, chain_raise and rat_hiss are both the alert cue and the wind-up cue; crawler_click is both wind-up and bite; gulp is beer and the teat gun reload; rocket_* and mag_out/bolt_rack/reload are shared by cow launcher / teat gun; shot_hinge, load, close, eject are shared by powder keg / bowling ball.

REPORT_GAIN trims loud cues (e.g. shotgun_both .64, saw_bounce .56, ripsaw .62); distant_* scale with the ambience slider, step_* with the footstep slider x.83; everything is multiplied by .82 x mix headroom.

Stings (shakedown_intro/_end, rudy/foreman/baron _intro/_end) play on a dedicated voice at music volume and are stopped when the score context changes; jerry_intro and got_bessie are ordinary effects. Stings are silent when music is toggled off.

Voice lines: only county_dispatch_0-4 and the 16 talk_<id>_<0|1> exchange lines have audio; the Barks one-liners (kill/streak/hurt/...) are caption text only, with a 35% chance of a yee_haw/yee_haw_alt on kill and streak barks.

Station cues come from level JSON: breaker_thunk, broadcast_cut (x2), fair_bell (fair); mill_isolate, brake_ratchet (x2), mill_trip (sawmill); mill_isolate, pressure_vent (x3), mill_trip, secret_slide, scenery_pipe (quarry); scenery_scrap (hickston feed-hatch).

Game.ALIAS rewrites weapon pickups 'riveter' -> bowling_ball and 'pressure_gun' -> cow_launcher, so in the Godot build the Mill Riveter and Copperhead (and riveter/riveter_pair/pressure_gun reports, their room_ twins, equip_/dry_/rivet_*/pressure_* reload cues, impact_rivet, impact_pressure, pressure_interrupt) are only reachable through the 'hickguns' cheat; they are still counted active. 'tnt' has no fire cue of its own (match_strike, fuse_hiss, tnt_throw, tnt_bounce, explosion).
Music is not looped per track: each chapter has a 3-track shuffled bag cut at music_ends.json; 'music' is the stem name of the first Hickston track.
